text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d i-n v-a-l-i-d g-p-s p-l-o-t c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n d g-e-o-s-p-a-t-i-a l m-e-t-a d-a-t-a s e t s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e s-i-t-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t-e-d s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e i-m-a-g-e r-y, l-e-f-t c-r-o-p-p-e-d a-n-d d-a-t-e t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d f-r-a-m-e s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l s-c-e-n-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-l-t-e-r-e-d v-e-r-i-f-i-e-r w-o-r-k p-a-p-e-r s, l-e-f-t a-m-b-i-g-u-o-u-s s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e b-l-o-c-k s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w l-a-y-e-r.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-a-f-t-e-d a f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-u-s m-a-r-k-e-t-i-n-g n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e, l-e-f-t c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y g-a-p s b-e-t-w-e-e-n p-r-o-m-i-s-e-s a-n-d d-a-t-a, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e q-u-e-s-t-i-o-n n-a-i-r.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-o-g-g-e-d f-a-l-s-e r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-g c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s, l-e-f-t t-r-a-i-l-i-n-g m-e-t-a d-a-t a i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c i-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e f-i-n-a l q-u-a-l-i-t-y a-s-s-u-r-a-n-c-e s-i-g-n-o-f-f.
